thread:
priya (Revenue Ops): FYI found a gap in the month-end deferred schedule after recon. Vendor CloudRack INV-80211 posted late and looks like the spring pricing experiment discount got routed as a revenue reduction instead of being treated as deferred prepay. Amount is $63,410. Can we decide revrec treatment before close? cc sam, rachel

accounting-bot: Vendor invoice received: INV-80211 (CloudRack). Amount: $63,410. Received 2026-03-25 09:12 UTC.

sam (Billing): I inspected mapping: line item has tag promo_discount; our billing logic converts that to contra-revenue. For vendor-billed prepay services, we should tag prepaid_hosted. So the invoice lowered recognized revenue instead of increasing deferred revenue.

rachel (Controller): Quick question: was any of this already captured in the close? If so, we need a reversing entry + correcting JE.

priya (Revenue Ops): Not yet posted to GL, it came in during the draft close window. We still have time to apply correction in this cycle.

joel (Finance Director): Outline the proposed entries and controls we need to lock down to prevent recurrence. Also include a sketch of P&L/BS movement.

sam (Billing): Proposed entry if we treat as 6-month prepay amortization (per contract):

```
Correcting Journal - March 2026
Dr Contra-Revenue 12,985
Cr Deferred Revenue 12,985
Memo: Reclassify CloudRack INV-80211 mis-tagged promo -> prepaid_hosted (partial posting reversal)

Then create deferred balance: Dr Cash/CAP 63,410 (if needed) ??? (we only need reclass on revenue lines)
```

priya (Revenue Ops): Numbers: total $63,410 should be deferred; if 6-month amort, monthly amort = $10,568.33. Looks like $12,985 of contra-revenue already posted by the billing pipeline (system auto-apply) so we need to reverse that and credit deferred for the full amount.

rachel (Controller): For audit trail I need: vendor invoice PDF, billing event export, the ratecard version used, and sign-off from Billing and Revenue Ops. Also need to confirm contract term (6 months) with legal or contracts.

priya (Revenue Ops): Uploading docs now: https://files.redwood/INV-80211.pdf and export https://files.redwood/billing/export-80211.csv. Ratecard snapshot: https://docs.redwood/pricing/ratecard-2026-03-20. Contract note: contract ID CR-4402 indicates 6-month term.

sam (Billing): I'll open a mapping patch to change promo_discount -> prepaid_hosted for vendor invoice lines where vendor = CloudRack and sku contains "hosted-commit". PR link will be in the workpaper.

joel (Finance Director): Rachel, do you approve the correcting JE template once backup is attached? If so, we'll route to accounting@redwood.com for posting before midnight close.

rachel (Controller): Approve contingent on docs. Once priya confirms contract and uploads the PDF, I'll sign the JE. Also please include a short note on why billing logic mis-routed the line (experiment flag leaked).

priya (Revenue Ops): Done - all docs uploaded and short root-cause note added to the workpaper: "experiment toggle did not update vendor mapping rules; vendor invoice generator applied promo flag to certain hosted lines."

sam (Billing): PR created: https://git.redwood/infra/billing-mappings/pulls/182. Workpaper created: WP-INV-80211-correction.

joel (Finance Director): Approved. Rachel, please post the JE and update the deferred revenue schedule. Also add a control item to the GAAP checklist: verify promo tag mapping for vendor invoices during close.

rachel (Controller): Will post JE tonight and update close pack. I'll tag the workpaper and include evidence links. Will also schedule a controls review item for next quarter.

priya (Revenue Ops): Thanks team. Quick ask: if anyone sees other CloudRack invoices in last 90 days with promo flags, drop them here so we can bulk check.

sam (Billing): I'll run a query tomorrow and post results. For now, only INV-80211 surfaced as mis-tagged in the draft run.

priya (Revenue Ops): Closing loop - thanks all. We'll monitor PR and control changes post-close.
